einzeiler: Hotel stay mishaps, travel habits, and golf dilemmas on the Dog Walk.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss their recent stay at the historic Ohio House Motel in downtown Chicago, which ultimately lacked air conditioning controls. They share their thoughts on hotel amenities like pools, room sharing, and contact lenses versus LASIK surgery. Additionally, they debate listener-submitted scenarios involving golf course etiquette.
stichpunkte: Staying at the Ohio House Motel in Chicago proved disappointing due to central air conditioning with no room thermostats and street noise.
Hotel preferences include debates over the necessity of pools, room temperature control, and bringing personal fans.
Sharing hotel rooms with coworkers on work trips brings up funny memories and awkward logistics.
Contact lens frustrations lead to a discussion about LASIK eye surgery and the associated costs and fears.
Listener dilemmas feature a golf group abandoning a legally blind golfer and a 12-year-old child dropped off to play golf on his birthday.
Upcoming travel plans include heading to Memphis and Ole Miss for college football coverage.
beschreibung:
On today's Free Swim, we start the show with Eddie giving a preview of his night at the Ohio House w/ Nick Turani. We then get into some of our favorite and strangest traveling habits. An on or off the leash question about our blind friends, and more.
